name: Creamy Sweet Potato-Corn Chowder with Bacon, Bell Pepper & Spinach

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg sweet potatoes
6 sticks celery
3 red bell peppers
1 small pkg fresh thyme
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the sweet potato.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until bacon has released its fat and is starting to brown, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
When the bacon is done, use a slotted spoon to transfer ½ to a plate; set aside. (Leave remaining bacon in the pot.)
Add veggies and corn to the pot with the remaining bacon, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are softened, 4-5 minutes more.
Meanwhile, slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems.

When the veggies are soft, add thyme, broth, water, and spices to the pot. Stir to combine the chowder, then bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sweet potatoes are tender and chowder has thickened, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1420 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 cup water
1 tbsp smoked paprika
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the sweet potatoes are done, reduce heat to medium-low. Add cream to the pot and, using a potato masher, gently crush some of the sweet potatoes to further thicken the chowder.
Add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide the chowder between bowls and sprinkle with reserved bacon. Enjoy!
